basic_info.description: Rarely available, 4-bedroom / 2-bath + Office, panoramic ocean view home with classic center-patio in the vibrant Central Sunset District is now available! Situated east to west on a large 3,000 sqft lot, natural sunlight permeates this traditional home! Perfect for entertaining! Main Level Features: large, formal living room with fireplace, bright dining area adjacent to sun-infused center-patio, large kitchen with abundant cabinet space, 2 bedrooms + full bath! Upper Level Features: Primary Suite w/full bath, huge closet, sitting area, office, deck & Panoramic Ocean Views! Lower Level Features: 1 bedroom, parking with interior access, abundant storage & garden access! With classic molding & wood floors throughout, this home presents a wonderful opportunity to make a San Francisco property your forever home. The location is phenomenal - walk to Noriega just a block away to enjoy cafes, shops, dining & transportation. Sunset Recreation Area with playground, basketball court, baseball field + more is just up the block. Irving Street is just over 4 blocks north & Taraval just over 5 blocks south! MUNI close by for easy access to Ocean Beach, GG Park, Financial District + more! Bonus: easy access to North / South Bays via 19th Avenue & Sunset Blvd.
